scripts.ci:pack: circleci config pack .circleci/development > .circleci/development.yml && circleci config pack .circleci/release > .circleci/release.yml
scripts.ci:check-pack: diff <(circleci config pack .circleci/development) .circleci/development.yml && diff <(circleci config pack .circleci/release) .circleci/release.yml || (echo 'CircleCI configs are out of date. Run: bun run ci:pack' && exit 1)
scripts.postinstall: mise exec -- lefthook install && { [ -n "$CI" ] || sst install; }
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo .sst node_modules packages/**/node_modules packages/**/.turbo packages/**/dist packages/cli/bin/.facet test-results/*.xml tmp docs/.mintlify
scripts.nuke: bun run clean && bun install && bun check
